sections.text: We will identify which surfaces still need treatment or monitoring while the opening remains available. Structural or utility changes require the appropriate qualified provider. The repair sequence will preserve necessary access rather than force a completion claim because replacement flooring has arrived.

sections.title: Give closure a specific set of findings
sections.text: The handoff will describe treated sections, remaining drying, and the plumbing correction status. Any unreachable area will remain identified. Replacement material should cover a resolved assembly, with each outstanding dependency stated before the next trade proceeds.

crawl-space-sewage-cleanup/farmers-branc.estimate: Clearance, exposed materials, wastewater distribution, and disposal requirements influence the estimate. Share the plumbing findings and planned work above the area.
checklist: Tell us what replacement work is planned.
